groupings.title: OliverSpec
groupings.description: Linear-backed explore → propose → scope → apply → babysit → ship, plus oliverspec-factory for single-ticket runs. Install as a suite: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/oliverspec

groupings.title: Babysit
groupings.description: Take one Linear ticket's open PRs through real CI and review fixes, explicit approval, and bottom-up merge. Install: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/babysit

groupings.title: Lab Notebook
groupings.description: Keep experiments and investigations in one Markdown file with a concise current summary and append-only chronological entries. Install: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/lab-notebook

groupings.title: Dashboard UI
groupings.description: Build compact, functional shadcn dashboards with layouts, charts, tables, and navigation suited to any domain. Install: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/dashboard-ui

groupings.title: UI Audit
groupings.description: Audit and polish an existing UI with rendered inspection and regression checks. Install: npx skills add chroline/oliver/skills/ui-audit
